title: The normalized ordinary vector integration mate is invertible
statement: Let $N>0$, let $A$ be a finite commutative ring with $NA=0$, and let $S$ be Noetherian with $N$ invertible. For a rank-$d$ vector bundle $\pi:E\to S$ and every $K\in D(S_{et},A)$, the adjunct under the ordinary ambient compact-support adjunction of inverse canonical coefficient-first projection followed by $1_K\otimes\int_\pi$ and the right unitor is invertible. The coefficient and trace are those of [def-amb-vector-integration], the bundle is [def-asd-vector-bundle-zero-section], and the ambient adjunction is [thm-amb-etale-exceptional-adjoint]. No boundedness restriction is imposed on $K$. The inverse projection is recorded by its local IsIso instance, supplied by finite projection formula.

proof.text: The actual vector integration is invertible: on a frame chart compact-support exchange identifies it with the affine-space top trace. Detect invertibility on the jointly surjective open cover using exact inverse image and derived cohomology. Tensoring the trace with K and composing inverse coefficient-first projection and the right unitor gives an invertible counit candidate c for every unbounded K.

Compare the ordered affine-space left functor with the ambient compact-support functor by induction on the coordinate tower, using the identity compactification at zero and compactification independence/composition at successors. Transport the affine adjunction along this comparison. Its counit at every K is invertible by induction from affineTraceLineCounit_isIso.

The natural Tate normal form of the affine right functor, its component at the unit, the pullback unit comparison, and tensor-shift comparison identify pullback K tensor right-adjoint-of-unit with the right adjoint at K. The vector chart coefficient comparison and pullback composition therefore identify the pulled-back source of the global adjunct with that right adjoint.

Under any two adjunctions with the same left functor, the adjunct of the second counit is the canonical right-adjoint comparison. Transport by the preceding source isomorphism. Because that counit and any invertible candidate c are invertible, c differs from the transported counit by an automorphism of K. Naturality of the hom equivalence now makes its Brown adjunct invertible.

Restrict the global adjunct to every frame. Invertible compact-support exchange gives an invertible local candidate c prime. Naturality of adjunction hom equivalences identifies the restricted global adjunct followed by the actual exceptional open base-change mate with the local adjunct. The latter is invertible by the preceding affine argument; the exceptional open mate is invertible by the existing theorem. Cancel it and detect invertibility on the frame cover. This proves the original all-complex statement without smooth duality.

proof_origin.place: Steps 5(c), 6, 7: affine adjunction on all complexes and frame descent. Replaces general smooth tensor duality by the affine counit and right-functor normal form.

lean.statement:
theorem vectorIntegrationMate_isIso (N : ℕ) (hN : 0 < N)
    (A : Type (u + 1)) [CommRing A] [Finite A] (hA : (N : A) = 0)
    (S : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian S] (hS : IsUnit (N : Γ(S, ⊤))) (d : ℕ)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{u} S.ringCatSheaf) [M.IsFiniteLocallyFreeOfRank d]
    (K : DerivedCategoryModule A S) :
    letI : IsAffineHom (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d M) :=
      (vectorIntegration_geometry S d M).1
    letI : LocallyOfFiniteType (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d M) :=
      (vectorIntegration_geometry S d M).2.1
    ∀ [IsIso (compactProjectionMapCoeffFirst A (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d M) K
        (vectorIntegrationCoefficient A N hA S d M))],
    IsIso ((rightDerivedUpperShriekAdjunction (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A)
      (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d M)).homEquiv _ K
        (inv (compactProjectionMapCoeffFirst A (VectorBundleZeroSection.π S d M) K
          (vectorIntegrationCoefficient A N hA S d M)) ≫
          ((derivedTensor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S).obj K).map
            (vectorBundleIntegration N hN A hA S hS d M) ≫
              (derivedTensorRightUnitor (ModuleCat.{u + 1} A) S K).hom))
